title: wmp.flow.complete — Notification
description: Flow reached a terminal state successfully.

credential_metadata.description: OpenID4VCI flows: the OpenID4VCI 1.1 response-level credential_metadata object, relayed verbatim. May carry secrets (org.siros.secret_seed): never log or retain it. Absent on a replayed completion, see redacted_members.

credential_metadata_encrypted_response.description: OpenID4VCI flows: true only when credential_metadata came in a JWE-encrypted issuer response.

refresh_token.description: OpenID4VCI flows: issuer refresh token. A secret; withheld from replayed completions.

dpop_jwk.description: OpenID4VCI flows: private JWK of the DPoP key the refresh token is bound to. A secret; withheld from replayed completions.

dpop_key_id.description: OpenID4VCI flows: identifier of the client-held DPoP key. Withheld from replayed completions.

redacted_members.description: Set only on a replayed completion: the secret members withheld from the retained copy.
